sections.description:
Advanced Autocomplete Orders for WooCommerce – Simplify WooCommerce Orders management and boost your store’s efficiency! Automatically update orders to ‘Completed’ right after purchase, ensuring a seamless experience for both you and your customers. Take control of your WooCommerce Order Status and save valuable time!

👉 User Guide | Youtube Video Tutorials | Get Support | Upgrade to Premium

An update does not change a store that leaves the new choices empty. Saved settings keep working. New choices stay off until you turn them on.

FEATURES

✅ Enable/Disable Autocompletion
✅ Order Types Restriction, including downloadable-only and mixed carts
✅ Order Total with a lowest and a highest amount
✅ Shipping Methods Restriction
✅ Payment Methods Restriction
✅ Complete as soon as the order is paid
✅ Skip orders that are not paid yet
✅ Products, Categories, Tags, Brands, and Types [PRO]
✅ User Roles and Current Order Status [PRO]
✅ More than one rule. The first rule that fits is the one that runs [PRO]
✅ Customers, guests, coupons, and billing or shipping address [PRO]
✅ Product details, quantities, backorders, and buyer history [PRO]
✅ Dates, days, hours, and a total for each currency [PRO]
✅ Wait before completing, choose another status, and choose the email [PRO]
✅ Check one order, look at old orders, and keep a log [PRO]
✅ Renewals, bookings, pre-orders, part payments, fraud holds, and tracking [PRO]
✅ Orders created in wp-admin, and in-person sales [PRO]
✅ Tell another app, copy rules to another site, and use the command line [PRO]

Managing orders efficiently is one of the biggest challenges for WooCommerce store owners. With the Advanced Autocomplete Order for WooCommerce plugin, you can now automatically complete orders in your WooCommerce store and streamline the entire order processing workflow.

This plugin is designed to automate order processing, saving you time and enhancing your store’s efficiency.

What Is Autocomplete WooCommerce Orders?

Updating Advanced Autocomplete Order for WooCommerce feature ensures that your WooCommerce store automatically updates order statuses without manual intervention. Once a customer completes their purchase, the plugin kicks in to automatically mark orders as complete, eliminating the need for store administrators to change statuses manually.

Whether you run a digital store or sell physical products, this tool helps you achieve seamless order processing by ensuring orders are processed efficiently from start to finish.

Which Features does Autocomplete WooCommerce Orders Cover?

✅ Enable/Disable Autocompletion
Easily toggle the autocomplete feature for WooCommerce orders. Perfect for stores needing manual processing or automated order management. Keeps your workflow flexible.

✅ Order Types Restriction
Limit autocomplete functionality based on specific WooCommerce order types like regular, subscription, or custom. Gain full control over how different orders are handled.

✅ Order Total (Min/Max) Restriction
Automatically complete orders only if their total amount falls within your defined range. Set minimum and maximum order total values, and decide whether to include or exclude them. Perfect for applying rules based on order value.

✅ Shipping Methods Restriction
Restrict order auto-completion based on selected shipping methods. Choose to include or exclude specific shipping options, ensuring only the right orders are auto-completed depending on how they are shipped.

✅ Payment Gateways Restriction
Allow or block autocompletion for specific WooCommerce payment methods (e.g., Cash on Delivery, PayPal, Stripe). Improve fulfillment accuracy based on payment behavior.

✅ Products Restriction [PRO]
Restrict automatic order completion based on individual products. Ideal for stores selling both digital and physical goods with different fulfillment needs.

✅ Product Categories Restriction [PRO]
Control autocompletion using WooCommerce product categories. Useful when certain categories (like pre-orders or subscriptions) require manual handling.

✅ Product Tags Restriction [PRO]
Enable fine-grained control by limiting autocompletion based on product tags. Easily manage special items like “backorder,” “custom-made,” or “exclusive.”

✅ Product Brands Restriction [PRO]
Use WooCommerce brand taxonomy to define autocompletion behavior. Great for stores working with multiple vendors or suppliers with different delivery methods.

✅ Product Types Restriction [PRO]
Target specific product types (simple, variable, downloadable, etc.) to customize the autocompletion workflow. Makes fulfillment smarter and product-aware.

✅ User Role Restriction [PRO]
Set rules based on WooCommerce user roles like Customer, Subscriber, or Wholesale Buyer. Offer custom experiences for different customer types.

✅ Current Order Status Restriction [PRO]
Trigger autocomplete only when orders are in specific statuses (e.g., Processing, On Hold). Gives you precision control over when an order is considered complete.

✅ Paid orders
Turn on “complete as soon as it is paid” if the thank-you page might never open. Turn on “paid orders only” to skip orders that are not paid yet. Both stay off until you choose them, so cash on delivery and bank transfer stores stay as they are.

✅ More than one rule [PRO]
Give each rule a name. The first rule that fits is the one that runs. Settings you already saved stay rule 1.

✅ Customers, coupons, and address [PRO]
Match guests, chosen customer emails, coupon codes, and the billing or shipping country, state, and postcode. You can also pick one shipping method from a zone. The shipping method type you already saved still works if you leave the new choice empty.

✅ What is in the order [PRO]
Match product details such as size or color, how many items are in the order, backorders, first-time or returning buyers, past orders, and money spent. Set a start and end date, days of the week, hours of the day, and a different order total for each currency.

✅ After a rule matches [PRO]
Wait minutes, hours, or days before completing. Set Completed, or another status you created. Keep the normal completed email, skip it, email the shop manager, or send a custom email. Existing rules still complete now, to Completed, with the normal email.

✅ Check your rules [PRO]
Type an order number and see which rule matched. Look at old orders before completing them. That button never runs by itself. A log shows orders that were completed and orders that were skipped.

✅ Other plugins and other apps [PRO]
Optional rules for subscription renewals, bookings, pre-orders, and part payments. Optional checks for fraud holds and shipment tracking. Optionally complete orders created in wp-admin and in-person sales. Tell another app when an order is auto-completed. Copy rules to another site, or run the same job with wp hawo check, wp hawo preview, and wp hawo complete.

👉 Upgrade to Premium

Streamlined Order Completion

The Autocomplete Orders plugin simplifies the order process by automatically setting your WooCommerce Order Status to “Completed.” No more manually updating order statuses; this plugin does the work for you, saving time and allowing you to focus on growing your business.

Boosted Customer Experience

With Autocomplete Orders, your customers will appreciate the immediate update of their Order Status. By automatically completing orders, you enhance customer trust and satisfaction, ensuring they know their purchases are being processed efficiently and without delay.

sections.faq:
Our plugin is user friendly, but here you can see some frequently asked
questions that can help you.

Can I use this plugin for physical products?

Yes, while it’s most commonly used for virtual and downloadable products, you can configure it to automatically set orders for physical products too.

What happens if I manually update an order status?

Manual updates will override the automatic settings, giving you full control when needed.

Will updating to 1.0.19 change orders I already complete?

No. Saved settings keep working. New choices stay off until you turn them on. Cash on delivery and bank transfer orders still complete on the thank-you page unless you choose otherwise.

Does this complete old orders by itself?

No. Looking at old orders, then completing them, is a button you press. An update does not go back and complete old orders.
sections.changelog:
1.0.19

  • Fixed: A saved order type now applies. An empty order type still completes every matching order.
  • Fixed: Product type rules now read the saved setting.
  • Fixed: A saved product also matches the variation the customer bought.
  • Fixed: Saving settings keeps existing values, including Pro settings.
  • Fixed: The missing WooCommerce notice uses this plugin’s name.
  • Added: Order types for every product downloadable, and for carts with both virtual and physical products.
  • Added: Optional switch to complete an order as soon as it is paid. Off for existing stores.
  • Added: Optional switch to skip orders that are not paid yet. Off for existing stores.
  • Added: Lowest and highest order total. A previously saved amount is kept.
  • Added: The order note now says which saved rules matched. The completed email still sends.
  • Added: More than one autocomplete rule. The first rule that fits is the one that runs. Current settings stay rule 1.
  • Added: Product match can be any product, every product, or only these products. Existing rules stay on any product.
  • Added: Guests, customer emails, coupon codes, billing and shipping address, and a shipping method from one zone.
  • Added: A checkbox on the product page and the category page adds that item to a later rule.
  • Added: Product details such as size, color, and other groups the store created.
  • Added: Filters for how many items, lines, and different products are in the order.
  • Added: A backorder choice, first-time and returning buyers, past orders, and money spent.
  • Added: A start and end date, days of the week, and hours of the day.
  • Added: A different order total for each currency. The single order total still applies to other currencies.
  • Added: Wait minutes, hours, or days before completing an order. No wait unless you set one.
  • Added: Set a status other than Completed. Existing rules still use Completed.
  • Added: Email choices to skip the completed email, email the shop manager, or send a custom email. Existing rules still send the normal completed email.
  • Added: A check for one order, a look at old orders before completing them, and a log of completed and skipped orders.
  • Added: Optional rules for subscription renewals, bookings, pre-orders, and part payments.
  • Added: Optional fraud-hold and shipment-tracking checks.
  • Added: Optional completion for orders created in wp-admin and for in-person sales.
  • Added: Tell another app when an order is auto-completed.
  • Added: Copy rules to another site, and run the same check from the command line.

1.0.18

  • Added: WooCommerce 10.6+ version compatibility.

1.0.17

  • Added: WordPress 6.9 version compatibility.

1.0.15

  • Added: Payment Methods Restrictions to Free version (gift for all).

1.0.14

  • Added: AppSero library added.

1.0.13

  • Added: Order Total(min/max) Restrcitions added.
  • Added: Shipping Methods Restrcitions added.

1.0.12

  • Added: Restrcitions guide added.

1.0.11

  • Updated: Readme updated.

1.0.10

  • Added: Enable/Disable settings.
  • Added: Order Type Restrictions (All virtual, any virtual, any downloadable products rules).
  • Added: Introduced Advanced Restrictions in advanced version.

1.0.9

  • Added: WordPress 6.8 compatibility added.

1.0.8

  • Added: WooCommerce 9.7 version compatibility.

1.0.7

  • Fixed: Critical error for wp-cli on specific server – issue has been fixed.

1.0.6

  • Added: Minor enhancement, optimized content.

  • Added: Minor enhancement, optimized content.

  • Added: Minor enhancement, optimized content.
